description: The flow that answers calls to a phone number claimed to an Amazon Connect instance. Set it with AssociatePhoneNumberContactFlow. A phone number has at most one flow. Deleting the resource removes the flow from the phone number.

PhoneNumberId.description: The ARN of the phone number, such as the PhoneNumberArn of an AWS::Connect::PhoneNumber. AWS finds a number claimed to a traffic distribution group only by its ARN in the group's other Region.

InstanceId.description: The ID of the Amazon Connect instance, such as the Id of an AWS::Connect::Instance. The phone number is claimed to it, or to a traffic distribution group of it.

ContactFlowId.description: The ID or ARN of the flow, such as the ContactFlowArn of an AWS::Connect::ContactFlow. AWS returns the flow's ARN.
